notes.title: New version coming soon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42387185/7db60bbb5cb98b11384b8af7ae1a30c4c4f8291b.png[/img]
Working on a new version with: an extra [b]level type[/b], [i]new game play [b]features / mechanics[/b][/i], [i]expanded [b]Options[/b] Menu[/i], [i]streamlined [b]UI / Menu Navigation[/b][/i], [i]more detailed [b]cut scenes[/b][/i], [i]more [b]detailed levels[/b][/i], [i]more [b]stable game play / input management[/b][/i], [i]more [b]Save Slots[/b][/i], [i]more possibilities for [b]future expansion[/b][/i]--more, more, more :)

More details [b]soon[/b]!
